name: getWinProgressBar
title: Current value of a Windows progress bar

origin.description: Return the current value of a winProgressBar.
origin.details: The Windows function reads the value by calling the setter with a NULL value. This R does not export it.

translation.description: Return the current Windows progress-bar value.
translation.details: A closed bar raises the C message about an invalid progress bar.
translation.example:
from utils import getWinProgressBar, winProgressBar
bar = winProgressBar(min=0, max=100, initial=50)
print(getWinProgressBar(bar))
